items.body_excerpt: The New Orleans Pelicans and Caleb Houstan have agreed to a one-year deal, league sources told HoopsHype. He’ll compete for the final Pelicans roster spot after shooting 52.4% from 3-point range with the Atlanta Hawks last season. He reunites with former Orlando Magic coach Jamahl Mosley.
